subject: Avoid log spam about cluster node failure detection by each primary (#2010)
reason: The change only lowers the log level of two cluster gossip messages (failure report added / removed) from LL_NOTICE to LL_VERBOSE in clusterProcessGossipSection. The failure-detection logic itself (clusterNodeAddFailureReport, clusterNodeDelFailureReport, markNodeAsFailingIfNeeded) is unchanged; no command reply, cluster state, replication, failover or persistence behavior differs between the builds. It is a logging-verbosity-only change with no externally observable behavior for the fuzzer's oracles or a compared command sequence to detect, so no scenario is needed.
